title: [Bug 644091] Separate B2B and B2C HSN summaries in GSTR-1 report
summary: The GSTR-1 report now handles B2B and B2C HSN summaries separately through conditional filtering based on the selected Nature of Supply, with fallback to combined output when no specific category is chosen.
key_points: HSN queries modified to support conditional filtering by Nature of Supply for B2B/B2C separation
Report Excel generation logic updated to independently summarize B2B and B2C HSN data
Blank Nature of Supply selection maintains backward compatibility by showing combined HSN output
Fixes duplicate rows and incorrect totals that occurred when both B2B and B2C data existed for the same HSN
Addresses GST portal requirements for separate B2B and B2C HSN reporting in GSTR-1
quote: Separate B2B and B2C HSN summary handling in the GSTR-1 report.
